 Nov 21, 2026 10:50AM
 Primeshow Entertainment, which scored a massive pan-India success with HanuMan, is expanding its cinematic universe with the next chapter, HanuMan 2 – The Rise of Vanaras. The production house has roped in Panja Vaisshnav Tej as the lead actor, with creative filmmaker VI Anand directing the project.
 The announcement has suprised many as Prashanth Varma created PVCU - Prashanth Varma Cinematic Universe, post the success of Hanu-Man and he planned direct sequel, Jai Hanuman with Rishab Shetty. He creative produced and written another PVCU film, Mahakali, as well. But prodcuers have decided to take this new direction. 
 They have stated that they own the title rights and can develop a new story around the premise. The makers unveiled the project with a striking title poster that features a man ascending through the clouds, accompanied by a gigantic celestial tail and a mystical presence.
 VI Anand, known for his imaginative storytelling and distinctive approach to fantasy, is expected to bring a different vision to this ambitious project. The combination of Anand's creative sensibilities and the mythology-driven world of HanuMan has raised curiosity about the film.
 Also Read: Aakasamlo Oka Tara Movie Review  
 For Vaisshnav Tej, the project marks a major comeback to the big screen after a gap. The actor will be seen in a fantasy spectacle that promises a new world and a different cinematic experience.
 With HanuMan 2 – The Rise of Vanaras, the makers are taking another significant step in building the HanuMan universe. Further details about the cast and production schedule are expected to be announced soon.
